Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

q: This card is linked to a Digimon.
If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?

a: Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.
q: Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card.
Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can also link to a Digimon in the breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I also use this card's [Main] effect to link to a Digimon in the breeding area?
